build_ResBlock: build a ResBlock residual block with configurable skip and residual transformation types for 3D video data
create_BasicTransformation: create a BasicTransformation module with two 3x3x3 grouped convolutions and batch normalization layers
create_PostactivatedBottleneckTransforma: create a PostactivatedBottleneckTransformation with Tx1x1, Tx3x3 group conv, and 1x1x1 projection layers
create_PreactivatedBottleneckTransformat: create a PreactivatedBottleneckTransformation with pre-activation batch norm and relu before each convolution layer
create_BasicR2Plus1DTransformation: create a BasicR2Plus1DTransformation that decomposes 3D convolutions into separate 2D spatial and 1D temporal convolutions
